Both npm-installed `dsh` and DSH Desktop on Windows are supported."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 🚀 Quick start"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"1. **Install the extension** from the Marketplace, or run:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"2. **Click the DSH whale** in the left Activity Bar or the right Secondary Side Bar.
3. **Done.** Th"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"e extension starts (or reuses) `dsh web`, signs the panel in, and shows DSH next to your code. No te"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"rminal, no browser tab, no manual login for a service it started itself."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Prerequisite:** install the `dsh` CLI from DeepSeek Harness and put it on your PATH — or install D"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"SH Desktop on Windows. If `dsh` is missing, the extension shows a hint; `DSH: Show Logs` prints the "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"detected path, source and version."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Other ways to install (VSIX / from source)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**VSIX package:** download the latest `dsh-vscode.vsix` from Releases, then in VS Code run `Extensio"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ns: Install from VSIX...` and reload the window."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**From source:**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 🎯 Why DSH in VS Code?"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| **Stay in the editor** | DSH lives in the sidebar or a side panel. Review code, run commands and t"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"alk to the agent without switching to a terminal or browser. |
| **Zero-config lifecycle** | The ext"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ension detects the port, reuses an existing `dsh web`, or starts one silently and loads it once read"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"y. Closing the window stops only the service it started. |
| **Native editor integration** | A small"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" bridge makes file paths clickable in VS Code, opens external links in your browser, routes copy but"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"tons through the extension host, and restores undo/redo in the embedded page. |
| **Auth that just w"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"orks** | DSH ≥ 0.1.2 prints a one-time launch URL; the extension exchanges it for a 30-day session a"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"nd serves the panel through a local loopback relay, so the cross-site iframe keeps working. |
| **Wo"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"rks where you work** | Local, WSL, SSH Remote, Dev Containers and Codespaces (remote scenarios are o"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"pt-in via `dsh.remote.enabled`). |
| **Private by design** | Loopback addresses only (`127.0.0.1` / "},{"id":"p17s11","text":"`localhost` / `[::1]`); no credentials are read; the relay is not exposed to the network. |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## 📸 Screenshot"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"*DSH embedded in the right-side panel — code and agent side by side.*"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## 🎬 Demo video"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"*59-second demo on Bilibili (Chinese): BV1p8bD6dE18*"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 🆕 What's new in 0.4.4"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Accurate stopping state** (#40): when you click **Stop Service**, the panel now says “Stopping D"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"SH service…” and the status bar turns orange — it no longer pretends to be “Starting”.
- **DSH Deskt"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"op on a non-default drive** (#41): if Desktop is installed outside `%LOCALAPPDATA%` (for example `H:"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"\DeepSeek Harness`), the extension now uses the Desktop command already on PATH as a fallback instea"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"d of failing with `ENOENT`.
- This is a maintenance release; no new panels or commands. Full history"},{"id":"p23s6","text":" with `ENOENT`.
- This is a maintenance release; no new panels or commands. Full history: CHANGELOG."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## ✨ Features at a glance"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Feature | What you get |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| 🖱️ **One-click open** | A whale icon in the left Activity Bar and the right Secondary Side Bar; th"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"e editor title bar has a white-bg whale that opens the right-side panel. |
| 🚀 **Service management*"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"* | Auto-detect the port; reuse a running `dsh web`, otherwise start one in the background. Port con"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"flicts temporarily fall back to the first free port, with a notification. |
| 🛟 **Recoverable errors"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"** | Dedicated pages for missing `dsh`, occupied port, start timeout, crash and disconnect — each wi"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"th a one-click reconnect. |
| 🔐 **Auth relay** | Parses the one-time launch URL, stores a 30-day ses"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"sion cookie, and forwards the panel through a loopback relay. Externally started services get a one-"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"time paste page. |
| 🔗 **Bridge integration** | File paths open in VS Code, external links open in y"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"our browser, copy buttons work, and undo/redo is restored in the embedded page. |
| 🖼️ **Images with"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"out vision** | Attach images even when the active model has no vision: the image is cached in the wo"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"rkspace and sent as a file-path reference; the model reads it with an image tool. Opt out with `dsh."},{"id":"p26s12","text":"image.fallback`. |
| 🌐 **Remote-ready** | SSH Remote, Dev Containers and Codespaces run `dsh` on the"},{"id":"p26s13","text":" remote and tunnel the panel; WSL works without a tunnel. |
| ⚙️ **Customizable** | Custom DSH profi"},{"id":"p26s14","text":"le, port, launch preference (npm / Desktop / auto), executable path, extra args, proxy env, timeout "},{"id":"p26s15","text":"and panel zoom. |
| 🌍 **Bilingual** | UI copy follows the VS Code display language: Chinese for `zh-"},{"id":"p26s16","text":"*`, English otherwise. |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## 🕹 Everyday use"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## 🏗 How it works"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The extension owns the service lifecycle and a local relay. The panel is an iframe inside a VS Code "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"webview; the extension host talks to `dsh web` on `127.0.0.1`. The bridge runs inside the DSH page a"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"nd relays editor actions through `postMessage`."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## 🧭 Known limitations"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Shift+drag from the VS Code Explorer (upstream)**: since VS Code 1.140, resource drags from the "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"Explorer no longer deliver `dragenter`/`dragover`/`drop` to a webview (microsoft/vscode#339278; the "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"upstream fix is still open). Use your system file manager or type `@` in the composer. Tracked in is"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"sue #37.
- **Image fallback needs a workspace folder**: files are cached under the workspace root; w"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"ith no folder open, the fallback is unavailable. Temporary images are cleaned up after use; `DSH: Cl"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"ean Up Image Cache` purges leftovers.
- **Externally started DSH (≥ 0.1.2)**: the extension cannot r"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"ead another process's log, so the first sign-in needs one paste of the launch URL (then up to 30 day"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"s). A service restart does not require pasting again."}],"truncated":true}
